summary: Niko Studio 端到端写作流程修复 + UI/UX打磨 + 入门引导
approach: 3-wave incremental delivery: (1) fix critical E2E breaks, (2) polish UX interactions, (3) add onboarding. Each wave builds on the previous, all backward-compatible.

waves.rationale: Critical E2E fixes — chapter state loss, AI context gap, API key UX block
UX polish — save shortcut, dirty check, cheatsheet, template manager
Onboarding — welcome wizard, novel templates, empty-state guidance

data_flow.diagram:
App.tsx → ProjectSidebar → DocumentEditor → NikoEditor → Tiptap
                  ↓                       ↓
              projectSlice         useEditorAI → /writing/stream → LLM
                  ↓                       ↓
           projectFileService    knowledgeService / characterManager
stages: User switches chapter → projectSlice.selectChapter → DocumentEditor loads content → NikoEditor mounts
User types / → SlashCommandMenu → useEditorAI → streamWritingHelper → /writing/stream → LLM response → editor
User clicks Export → ExportDialog → exportDocx → DOCX download

design_decisions: Editor state cache: Map<chapterId, {json, text, selection, scrollY}> in DocumentEditor — avoids Tiptap remount by removing key prop when cached state exists
AI context enrichment: new hook useStoryContext() that reads characterManager, foreshadowing, worldview from zustand/API — appends to contextBefore in editorAIPromptPolicy
Onboarding: standalone WelcomeWizard component with 3 steps (project create → API key → start writing), gated by localStorage flag 'niko-onboarding-done'
